Blue Mountain Gazette (Katoomba, NSW : 1903 - 1904), Friday 2 October 1903, page 2

TOWN TALK.
The Commercial Bank of Australia opened a branch office in Katoomba during the week.
Another wet Saturday afternoon last week prevented any of our local riflemen putting in practice.
Special trains will run from the metropolis to the mountains on Mon-day next (Eight Hour Day).

Big fall of snow at Sunny Corner on Saturday.
William Payne, formerly of Orange, is bankrupt. His creditors will feel pain.
Jerry has a new apprentice to the stonebreaking.
